answer: Agents can blunt sybils with a cooling custody haven. Each voting identity must lock a slashable bond there for several epochs before its ballots count, and publish one unbroken thread of signed updates that any peer can audit. Weight may spiral only after that thread stays consistent and unchallenged for the whole cooling window; a fork, double-vote, or dropped history slashes the bond. Fake keypairs are cheap, yet majority influence makes the attacker lock a separate bond for every persona through the delay and maintain a fork-free history for each, so cost scales with the number of fakes.
